Compliance Answer: Vulnerable customers should be protected through tailored communication and product suitability assessments to mitigate risks of financial harm, as mandated by the Act on Prevention of Money Laundering and Combating Terrorism Financing.
2. Relevant Regulatory Basis: 4106022-8act9of2017finansectorregulationa.pdf (Chunk 4398)
3. Explanation: The Act requires financial institutions to protect vulnerable customers by ensuring that they are not exposed to activities deemed risky and fraudulent, as well as safeguarding the public interest through measures against money laundering and terrorism financing (vi-viii). Tailored communication can help in understanding their specific needs while product suitability assessments ensure that customers only engage with appropriate financial products.
